lina (PM): FYI — big customer asks for an automated "optimize advisor" that suggests batching, cache and quantization settings per route. They want launch gated by clear econ/reliability rules. Can we sketch an MVP and required gating?
kevin (PM): +1. Goal: surface config recs that are actionable (one-click apply) and a warning when quality might drop. Prioritize: 1) batching heuristics 2) prefix/KV cache recommendations 3) quantization guidance.
sam (Eng): Technical reality check: dynamic batching rules are doable, but per-route model + seq-len histograms needed. For caching we need request fingerprinting (hash keys) and TTL heuristics. Quantization recs require offline eval against a few prompt families — heavy.
nana (DataSci): typo: i'm ana — for quality gating we can use eval-triggered alerts with a small held-out prompt set and KL/ROUGE-ish signals. Need >=200 prompts per route for stable signals; for high-variance routes maybe 500.
kevin (PM): Good point. Customer asked for "safety rails": if predicted quality delta > X or latency regress > Y, don't recommend apply. What should X/Y be?
nana (DataSci): Suggest X = 3% relative drop in preferred metric (e.g., accuracy/F1/ROUGE); Y = 15% latency increase. Those are conservative. We can tune post-pilot.
sam (Eng): Implementation notes: batching rec will include target batch size, window ms, and a fallback to small-batch low-latency mode. Cache rec will recommend key strategy and warmup policy. Quant rec will be binary: "safe" or "needs-eval" unless we run small AB tests. Each rec should include an estimated token-cost delta.
patrick (SRE): Rollout gating: no auto-apply in prod unless canary pass and SLOs hold for 24h. Need an ops flag to disable auto recommendations per-tenant. Also add alert if apply spikes GPU memory or queue lat.
lina (PM): OK — draft MVP acceptance criteria from this thread: 1) UI shows per-route recs (batch/cache/quant) with cost delta and predicted quality delta. 2) Eval-triggered guardrails run on a sample set and flag risky recs. 3) One-click 'apply to canary' that creates canary job and monitors SLOs for 24h. 4) Admin toggle to disable auto-apply. Anyone object?
sam (Eng): fine. For MVP we'll scope quantization recs to model families we already have quant pipelines for (Llama2 variants + small mix of community models). Full model support later.
nana (DataSci): We'll build a simple signal page showing metric drift + sample outputs for any flagged route. Also add an opt-in email digest for customers about recs.
kevin (PM): Prioritization ask: do we bundle this with Optimize advisor kickoff or ship as "advisor-lite" separate? My view: ship advisor-lite (batch+cache + alerts) in Q3, then add quant recs and one-click autopilot in Q4.
lina (PM): I'm ok with that. Let's capture owners & immediate next steps: - Sam: prototype batching heuristic + cost estimate (due in 2 weeks) - Ana: assemble 200-prompt eval sets for top 10 customer routes (2 weeks) - Patrick: design canary gating playbook & ops toggle (1 week) - Kevin/Lina: write pilot invite + success metrics (SLO change tolerances, customer acceptance criteria)
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly product sync Thu 10:30am. Added action items to the backlog: PROD-1456 (advisor-lite prototyping).
kevin (PM): Quick safety question — metrics to show in UI: predicted cost delta, predicted latency delta, quality delta (%), confidence band, and suggested rollouts. Any other must-haves?
sam (Eng): include estimated memory change for quant recs. Also show a simple explanation string for why we chose a rec (e.g., "80% of requests < 128 tokens; batch=16 recommended").
lina (PM): Sounds good. If no blockers I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with eng+data+SRE tomorrow to confirm scope and timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
